audit: Independent hostile audit of Spin(9) complex-spinor pure-moment geometry and canonical-EB support

claims.claim: Every complex pure ray in the Spin(9) 16-dimensional complex spinor representation is classified for the moment calculation by p=|psi^T psi|^2 and t=||y_7||^2 after phase fixing and Spin(9) reduction; all p,t in [0,1] are attained.
claims.reason: Spin(9) is transitive on the real spinor sphere with point stabilizer Spin(7); the isotropy module splits as 7+8. Spin(7) acts transitively on the spin-8 unit sphere with stabilizer G2, and G2 acts transitively on the standard-7 unit sphere. The p=0 phase ambiguity is resolved by invariant s1=t, independently also by R=sum_i|psi^T Gamma_i psi|^2=1+(1-p)(1-2t). Endpoints are included.

claims.claim: The exact grade scores are s1=p+(1-p)t, s2=(1-p)(1+3t), s3=(1-p)(7-3t), s4=7(1+p)-(1-p)t.
claims.reason: Reconstructed using Hopf-vector grade-one identity, Spin(8) generator frame/Casimir for grade two, exact Fano-triple counts for grade three, and Clifford-basis Parseval for grade four; independently reduced exact symbolic Clifford sums in the 16-dimensional octonion model.

claims.claim: The set of pure-seed grade moment vectors is exactly conv{(1,0,0,14),(0,1,7,7),(1,4,4,6)}.
claims.reason: The moment vector equals p*v0+(1-p)(1-t)*vH+(1-p)t*vV; these are all simplex weights and every point is attained by an explicit representative.

claims.claim: For every nonnegative invariant sector weight alpha, the support over full-domain canonical EB channels equals max{alpha dot v0, alpha dot vH, alpha dot vV}.
claims.reason: The score F_alpha(rho) is convex in rho when alpha>=0, so decomposing any higher-rank normalized effect into pure states upper bounds its score by the pure-seed maximum. A Spin(9) orbit POVM attains each vertex. The formula applies to canonical channels that prepare each effect's normalized state, not unrestricted EB channels with independent preparations.
claims.scope_caveat: Not every canonical EB transfer vector belongs to the pure-seed triangle; the canonical replacer has vector zero. The exact support statement remains valid.

claims.claim: For every pure seed, M(dg)=16 P_g dg and preparation P_g define a full-domain canonical EB channel that is trace preserving, unital, CP, EB, and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint; for invariant weights its score equals the seed score.
claims.reason: Complex irreducibility and Schur averaging give integral P_g dg=I/16. The effects integrate to I; Psi(I)=16 integral P_g dg=I. Each summand is positive rank-one measure-and-prepare with identical effect/preparation state; invariance fixes the score across the orbit.

claims.claim: The three winner cones have 6, 6, and 7 extreme rays and their union is the stated set of ten rays, with ties as listed in REPORT.md.
claims.reason: Independent rational active-normal triple enumeration verifies full-dimensional strict witnesses, rank-three active normals at each extreme ray, exact per-cone lists, and all winning-score ties.

claims.claim: If the full star gap is PSD at the ten union rays on every correct representation block, it is PSD for every nonnegative alpha.
claims.reason: On each winner cone the gap is a linear matrix-valued map; each full-dimensional pointed polyhedral cone is generated by the enumerated extreme rays, so every gap is a nonnegative linear combination of its ray gaps. Shared ties agree in the scalar support term.
claims.not_verified: The parent star matrices, representation reduction, and their exact PSD minors were not independently audited in this task.

claims.claim: The full Spin(9)-covariant common-canonical-EB comparator follows from the candidate star bound plus separation.
claims.reason: This audit establishes the EB support side and cone reduction only. The broadcaster Choi construction, exact three-copy star block identities/PSD certificates, and complete minimax/separation interface must be independently valid in the other proof components.
claims.scope_boundary: No noncovariant all-channel, unrestricted-EB, universal dimension-free, or external novelty claim is supported here.

reproducibility.environment_note: Requires Python 3 and SymPy. Exact arithmetic is used for the local Clifford and cone checks; these scripts are not a formal proof assistant.
